entries.text: The TPC-DS runner no longer carries ClickHouse Q47, Q57, Q66, Q90 and PostgreSQL rollup `ORDER BY lochierarchy` overrides; they run as the bundled SQLGlot runtime's `nullif_zero_divisors` (Q90, every dialect), `inline_order_by_aliases` (Q36, Q70, Q86 on the PostgreSQL family), `alias_qualified_projections` (ClickHouse Q47, Q57) and `qualify_alias_shadowed_columns` (ClickHouse Q66). ClickHouse Q47, Q57 and Q66 now keep the dsqgen shape instead of being split into extra CTEs, and the TPC-DS OBT ClickHouse path uses the same rewrites. Every ClickHouse query also goes through `decimal_division_to_double` (a quotient keeps its fractional digits instead of the dividend's scale), `use_nulls_for_rollups` (rolled-up keys are NULL, as on every other engine) and, for TPC-H Q6, the exact-decimal `BETWEEN` bounds. On ClickHouse, TPC-DS Q2, Q5, Q12, Q14, Q20, Q36, Q59, Q66, Q77, Q80, Q98 and TPC-H Q6 now return the DuckDB rows at SF0.01, and TPC-H Q8 and the TPC-DS Q2, Q12, Q20, Q36, Q59, Q66 and Q98 quotients change at larger scale. Published ClickHouse results for these queries, and other ClickHouse bundles with division or `ROLLUP`, were produced before this change.
